UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
Case No. 1:26-cv-02331
V.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED
CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AND REQUEST FOR SUBMISSION
ON THE PAPERS
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine waives oral argument on Plaintiff's Motion for Referral to
an Early Settlement Conference, submitted on November 3, 2026, and requests that the Court
direct submission and determination of that Motion on the papers under Local Civil Rules 7(E)
and 7(J) and Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b).
1

This waiver applies only to argument on the referral motion. It does not withdraw the
requested settlement conference or alter any hearing request, notice, or waiver concerning another
pending matter.
Date: November 3, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com
2

CERTIPICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that on November 3, 2026, I submitted the following documents to the Clerk of
Court for filing through the Court's Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS):
1.
Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument and Request for Submission on the Papers,
with its Certificate of Service, Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) Certification, and Generative Artificial
Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification.
Counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, Katie
Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc. are registered users of the Court's Case Management/Electronic
Case Filing (CM/ECF) system. Upon the Clerk's docketing of the submission, the CM/ECF system
will transmit a Notice of Electronic Filing to each of them, and service will be made through that
means under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 5(b)(2)(E). EDSS submission is not itself service.
Date: November 3, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se

CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO LOCAL CIVIL RULE 83.1(N)
Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N), 1 declare under penalty of perjury that no attorney
has prepared, or assisted in the preparation of, Plaintiff's Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument and
Request for Submission on the Papers, including the Certificate of Service, this Certification, and
the Generative Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification accompanying it.
Name of Pro Se Litigant: Marvelle J. Ballentine
Signature of Pro Se Litigant
Executed on: November 3, 2026
4

GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE DISCLOSURE AND CITATION
CERTIFICATION
Plaintiff prepared this filing in part using generative Al-assisted agentic motion drafting
through a proprietary methodology under development by Plaintiff. Plaintiff certifies that he has
reviewed all citations to legal authorities and the record for accuracy.
Date: November 3, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
